components.name: Workspace Action (Pending)
components.description: The active-language primary boundary inside a focused unit, shown disabled until the workspace destination exists.
components.html: <button class="ds-workspace-action" type="button" disabled lang="en" dir="ltr">Workspace coming soon</button>
components.css: .ds-workspace-action { min-height: 3.35rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.65rem; background: var(--accent); color: #fff; padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem; font: 700 0.72rem/1.4 var(--font-unimind-latin), var(--font-unimind-arabic), sans-serif; } .ds-workspace-action:focus-visible { outline: 0.1875rem solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 0.1875rem; } .ds-workspace-action:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.78; }

components.name: Catalog Search
components.description: A quiet full-width search field with a dedicated logical icon cell that prevents overlap in either text direction.
components.css: .ds-search { min-height: 2.85rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; border: 0.0625rem solid #30445e; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--surface-strong); padding-inline: 0.9rem 1rem; } .ds-search svg { width: 1.3rem; height: 1.3rem; fill: none; stroke: var(--text-muted); stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; pointer-events: none; } .ds-search-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; width: 100%; min-height: 2.7rem; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary); padding: 0; caret-color: var(--accent); text-align: start; font: 400 1rem/1.5 var(--font-unimind-latin), var(--font-unimind-arabic), sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #aab7c7; opacity: 1; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: transparent; outline: 0.1875rem solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 0.1875rem; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: none; }

components.name: Current Product Navigation
components.description: The current active-language destination with a filled field and logical-edge cobalt marker.
components.html: Study Shelf
components.css: .ds-nav-current { position: relative; min-height: 4.25rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.2rem minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--surface-active); color: #8db4ff; padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem; text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-unimind-latin), var(--font-unimind-arabic), sans-serif; } .ds-nav-current::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset-block: 0.45rem; inset-inline-start: -0.45rem; width: 0.1875rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent); } .ds-nav-current svg { width: 1.65rem; height: 1.65rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; } .ds-nav-current > span > span { display: block; } .ds-nav-current span[lang="ar"] { margin-block-start: 0.15rem; font: 400 0.78rem/1.5 var(--font-unimind-arabic), sans-serif; } .ds-nav-current:hover { color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-nav-current:focus-visible { outline: 0.1875rem solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 0.1875rem; }

components.name: Locale Switch
components.description: A compact binary language control with an explicit pressed state.
components.css: .ds-locale-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 0.0625rem solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.2rem; background: #0a1520; } .ds-locale-switch button { min-width: 2.9rem; min-height: 2.2rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-unimind-latin), var(--font-unimind-arabic), sans-serif; } .ds-locale-switch button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--surface-active); color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-locale-switch button:hover { color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-locale-switch button:focus-visible { outline: 0.1875rem solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 0.1875rem; }

components.name: Shelf Unit Card
components.description: A compact active-language curriculum unit that keeps image, identity, and progress in a strict shelf tile.
components.html: Anatomy2/8 units
components.css: .ds-unit-card { width: 11.55rem; min-height: 14.75rem; overflow: hidden; border: 0.0625rem solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-card); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text-primary); font-family: var(--font-unimind-latin), var(--font-unimind-arabic), sans-serif; } .ds-unit-image { height: 8.9rem; background: var(--canvas-deep); } .ds-unit-copy { min-height: 5.8rem; padding: 0.7rem 0.75rem 0.8rem; } .ds-unit-copy > bdi { display: block; font-size: 0.96rem; font-weight: 720; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-unit-copy > bdi[lang="ar"] { margin-block-start: 0.28rem; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 400 0.84rem/1.45 var(--font-unimind-arabic), sans-serif; } .ds-progress { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; margin-block-start: 0.62rem; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 0.72rem; } .ds-progress > span { flex: 1; height: 0.42rem; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 999px; background: #2e4259; } .ds-progress i { display: block; width: 25%; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--ready); } .ds-unit-card:hover .ds-unit-image { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-unit-card:focus-within { outline: 0.1875rem solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 0.1875rem; }

components.name: Focused Shelf Unit
components.description: The signature expanded unit that exposes active-language identity, readiness, scope, source count, and an honest destination boundary.
components.html:
Cardiovascular Module✓ Ready
12 approved sources · cohort scope
components.css: .ds-focused-unit { width: 23.85rem; min-height: 19.8rem; overflow: hidden; border: 0.0625rem solid var(--accent-focus); border-radius: var(--radius-card); outline: 0.125rem solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -0.125rem; background: var(--surface-focus); color: var(--text-primary); box-shadow: 0 1rem 2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22); font-family: var(--font-unimind-latin), var(--font-unimind-arabic), sans-serif; transition: width 360ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-focused-summary { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9.7rem minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: stretch; } .ds-focused-image { min-height: 10.75rem; background: var(--canvas-deep); } .ds-focused-summary > div:last-child { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 1rem; } .ds-focused-summary bdi { display: block; font-weight: 720; font-size: 1.02rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-focused-summary bdi[lang="ar"] { margin-block-start: 0.28rem; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 400 0.84rem/1.45 var(--font-unimind-arabic), sans-serif; } .ds-focused-ready { width: fit-content; margin-block-start: 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.55rem; background: var(--ready-surface); color: var(--ready); padding: 0.42rem 0.6rem; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-focused-details { border-block-start: 0.0625rem solid #3a4f68; padding: 0.75rem 1rem 0.9rem; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 0.78rem; } .ds-focused-unit:hover { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-focused-unit:focus-within { outline-width: 0.1875rem; outline-offset: 0.1875rem; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-focused-unit { transition: none; } }

components.name: Ready Status

components.css: .ds-ready-status { width: fit-content; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; border-radius: 0.55rem; background: var(--ready-surface); color: var(--ready); padding: 0.42rem 0.6rem; font: 700 0.8rem/1.4 var(--font-unimind-latin), var(--font-unimind-arabic), sans-serif; } .ds-ready-status svg { width: 1.05rem; height: 1.05rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-ready-status span span { display: block; } .ds-ready-status span[lang="ar"] { margin-block-start: 0.08rem; font: 700 0.72rem/1.4 var(--font-unimind-arabic), sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
UniMind is a dense but calm academic workspace. Deep matte fields and restrained subject plates let students scan authorized curriculum units as a set of ordered shelves, while off-white type and thin cool-blue separators maintain serious, work-focused clarity. The system is expressive through precise focus behavior, not decoration.

The signature transition turns one shelf item into a trustworthy study doorway: the focused unit expands in place, reveals its identity and state in the active language, and keeps neighboring choices visible. The visual language explicitly rejects the generic LMS dashboard, hospital-software sterility, and chatbot-first shells, while avoiding entertainment browsing cues.
keyCharacteristics: Dark matte surfaces with low elevation and one cobalt interaction voice.
Compact, locale-switchable hierarchy built for scanning in English or Arabic, including mixed-direction technical content.
Horizontal academic rails whose focused item expands without hiding catalog context.
State communicated through text, icons, shape, and contrast rather than color alone.
Restrained, synthetic subject imagery with replaceable provenance-tracked assets.

rules.name: The One Cobalt Voice Rule
rules.body: Cobalt identifies focus, current location, and the primary action; do not scatter it as decoration.

rules.name: The State Is Redundant Rule
rules.body: Readiness and unavailability always pair color with explicit text plus an icon or other non-color cue.

rules.name: The Active Language Rule
rules.body: Render one selected interface language at a time. Every visible interface label, state, and description follows the active locale; only the language switch shows both choices.

rules.name: The Shelf Context Rule
rules.body: Expansion happens inside the rail: keep neighboring curriculum choices visible instead of opening an entertainment-style overlay.

rules.name: The Matte-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Default surfaces do not float; reserve the single structural shadow for the focused shelf item.

rules.name: The Strict Tile Rule
rules.body: Keep shelf items visually rectangular and aligned even when focused; expansion changes width and information density, not the underlying form language.

dos: Do keep application surfaces in Operate mode: scanability, state clarity, and familiar controls outrank expression.
Do keep multiple curriculum rails and adjacent units visible at representative desktop widths.
Do render only the active locale, preserve semantic language and direction attributes, and keep logical CSS properties, keyboard focus, touch targets, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use synthetic, provenance-tracked, replaceable subject imagery as restrained academic context.
Do state availability, readiness, and pending destinations truthfully with text plus a non-color cue.
donts: Don't turn the shelf into a generic LMS dashboard, hospital-software interface, or chatbot-first shell.
Don't imitate streaming entertainment with posters, autoplay, hover-only disclosure, or cinematic overlays.
Don't add gamification, glassmorphism, neon glow, excessive animation, remote runtime assets, or invented claims.
Don't treat medical imagery as proof of approved sources, real curriculum, or availability.
Don't create separate LTR and RTL visual systems or allow mixed-direction labels to merge without isolation.
